mistake_reason: At step 2, Orchestrator instructed WebSurfer to search the web for identities associated with the provided file instead of using FileSurfer to read the attached local JSON-LD. This is a classic FM-4.3 Tool Selection Error: the agent selected an inappropriate tool (web browsing) for a subtask that required parsing the local attachment. As a result, the team used a mismatched set of ORCID profiles not guaranteed to be the ones in the file, producing incorrect counts and an erroneous average.
